name: nautilus
description: Nautilus is a lightweight tracing JIT compiler for C++

paragraphs: Nautilus is a lightweight, tracing just-in-time (JIT) compiler for C++. Write imperative C++ using val wrapper types, and Nautilus traces the control flow and operations of your function, converts the trace into an intermediate representation (IR), optimizes it, and compiles it to efficient code through one of several interchangeable backends, trading off compilation latency against code quality at runtime.

Nautilus was developed by the DIMA group at TU Berlin and is used as the query compiler of the data management system NebulaStream. Its design is described in a SIGMOD 2024 paper (see Publication below).
▶ Try Nautilus in your browser: no setup required
